description: This file is a Python script for downloading and verifying binaries from S3, including functions for hashing, progress reporting, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: compute_file_sha256
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a file at a given path.

methods.name: report_download_progress
methods.description: Displays download progress as a progress bar.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies if a binary exists and matches the reference hash; deletes it if not.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a binary from a URL, verifies its hash, and sets executable permissions.
